name: Edge Feature Release Pipeline
description: End-to-end full-stack release workflow: audit PostgreSQL RLS migrations, verify UI accessibility, deploy Cloudflare Worker, and open a GitHub PR.

nodes.label: Release Request
nodes.description: Triggered when preparing a production feature release touching schema, UI, and edge API.

nodes.label: postgres-schema-guardian
nodes.description: Validate SQL migrations and Row-Level Security policies.

nodes.label: react-ui-accessibility
nodes.description: Audit dark mode, semantic landmarks, and keyboard navigation.

nodes.label: Pre-Deploy Verification Gate
nodes.description: Require passing SQL checks and zero P0 accessibility regressions.

nodes.label: cloudflare-workers-deploy
nodes.description: Dry-run and publish Cloudflare Worker bindings.

nodes.label: github
nodes.description: Create release summary PR and attach verification report.

nodes.label: Signed Release Summary
nodes.description: Emit final deployment digest with rollback ID.
